name: Multi-speaker scene (people talking around a patient or a product)
state: seeded from 3 cut runs + 2 matched grandma-format runs, 2026-10-10
what: Real-looking people in one or a few rooms talking — to the lens and to each other — around one person's problem and the product: the three-doctors consult, the live TV-shopping demo, the grandma test bench. Every speaker in their own cloned voice; on-camera lines spoken inside the clip; faults covered at the edit before anything is remade.

specialised.what: voices first, every speaker their own cloned voice, kept once approved
specialised.why: a run re-recorded approved voices and drifted them (the three-doctors run vo-drifted-2026-10-01); every speaker reads in their own voice (CLAUDE.md 2026-09-23)

specialised.what: on-camera lines are said inside the Omni clip, then speech-to-speech into the cast voice + the crisp finish
specialised.why: the owner 2026-10-03: "version a actually sounds like the avatar looks"
lip-sync and identity are the whole read of a talking head; 360p is a song-ad saving, not this family's

specialised.what: cover a fault at the edit before remaking it — close-ups, 7% punch-ins, b-roll, cloned-voice word patches
specialised.why: the owner 2026-10-09: "only regenerate what's absolutely necessary… cover issues up with zoom ins b-roll"

specialised.what: never cut off a word; a dropped word is patched in the speaker's cloned voice
specialised.why: the owner 2026-10-04: "We should never be cutting off words"

specialised.what: music bed for the whole edit, ducked under the voices
specialised.why: the owner 2026-10-04: "we need the music for the whole edit"

specialised.what: pictures one quality step down (high), made at 9:16 with the subject zone in the first prompt; no zone-fix pass
specialised.why: a subject-zone fix re-made 32 pictures on the three-doctors run and ran on every grandma run; cost target

stage_order: writing (the hook stays as the format has it)
clips (Omni 1080p, on-camera lines in the clip)

audio.on_camera: said inside the clip, then speech-to-speech into the speaker's cloned voice + crisp finish
audio.off_camera: the speaker's cloned voice on its own track
audio.turns: each speaker waits their turn — no overlapping murmurs

pictures.subject_zone: 15–85% of the height, said in the first prompt
pictures.style_lock: the swipe's style row (phone-grade realism on every run so far)
pictures.only_these_things: list every prop; nothing from the swipe's own props leaks in

clips.cut_at: line or sentence boundaries, never padded
clips.person_from: the section's approved picture, never a made frame
clips.restart_on_same_picture: 7% punch-in so the join reads as a jump cut

cast.reuse: banked cast first (the same presenter served four formats); new cast only for the roles a format adds (host, artist, doctors)
cast.product: real pixels — real archive clip, studio render or the turntable paste (live-action family)

hooks.shape: the hook stays as the format has it; 4–5 alternate openings swap the first scene or line (G01-H2…H6)

captions.look: ig-fb-native (Instagram/Facebook) unless the source has none

apply: line parity on every talking clip
mouths reviewed (a silent person's lips moving)
picture QC with a working reviewer

edit.method: video-edit machine cut on the voice track
edit.lip_offset: measure in each clip's own frames; one global picture offset when the whole cut is a frame off
edit.music: bed for the whole edit, ducked about -19 dB under voice

failures.failure: a run re-recorded voices already approved; they drifted
failures.fix: approved takes restored; voices are kept, never re-recorded by a run

failures.failure: the picture reviewer crashed (JSONDecodeError); 21 pictures came back unreviewed
failures.fix: the owner reviewed; a crashed reviewer is a stop, never a pass
subject zone said in the first prompt (the zone-fix re-made 32 pictures)

failures.failure: product drawn at the wrong size
failures.fix: a product-scale rule in the picture prompt; product pixels from the real kit

failures.failure: lips moving with no words on a silent person
failures.fix: close-ups with the mouth out of frame
trim the line; patch the missing words in the speaker's cloned voice (word_fix.py)

failures.failure: the clip wrote words on a shirt / a third hand appeared
failures.fix: crop punch-in past it / cover with b-roll

failures.failure: lip sync about one frame off across the cut
garbled small label text passed by the clip gate
failures.fix: blur or punch past at the edit

failures.failure: the swipe's own props leaked into a picture; a person given glasses
failures.fix: "ONLY these things…" — the prompt lists every prop and look

failures.failure: the clip model kept erasing the skin spot
Omni cut to a new framing inside one call
failures.fix: flagged at QC; one continuous take is in every clip prompt
"soft tan, golden-beige cream" — the product's real colour in words, from the kit

failures.failure: the mouth tracker read a background screamer, not the lead
two shots planned on a clip door the provider does not offer
failures.fix: plan only the ruled door (Omni image-to-video / reference-to-video)

cost.measured: the three-doctors run ~$__ (79 i2v clips at 1080p, 108+39 picture calls); TV shopping $__; test bench $__; body scan $__; public reaction $__ (ledger.json each)
cost.how: pictures at high not xhigh, subject zone in the first prompt (no zone-fix pass), cover at the edit before any remake, 1–2 clips per picture where a speaker stays in one set-up, banked cast

quality_bar: every word heard, none cut off (line parity on every talking clip)
lips on the words within a frame
a silent person's lips never move on screen
every speaker sounds like their face — their own cloned voice
no third hand, no words written on clothes or walls, no garbled labels left readable
the product is the real thing at its real size and colour
the room stays the same room across a scene (props, light, wardrobe)
music bed under the whole edit, never fighting the voice

variants.name: Expert consultation (the three doctors)
variants.what: one presenter takes the same problem to several experts in turn; the experts disagree; the last answer is the product

overrides.stages.edit.broll: none before the last expert (the owner 2026-10-03: "put broll on top early … do not do that at all"); real b-roll ~4 s after
overrides.stages.edit.cards: OPTION 1 / 2 / 3 in a native pop (white bold sans, dark rounded box); no receipt or price cutaways (the owner 2026-10-03)
overrides.stages.cast.roles: the presenter + the experts, a wardrobe change marking each consultation; spots shown on bare skin

variants.name: Live TV-shopping demo
variants.what: a host to the lens runs a live demo on a model while an artist applies the product — a demonstration, never a price ad

overrides.stages.edit.cards: a live demonstration, not a value (price) ad (the owner 2026-10-09)
overrides.stages.cast.roles: host to the lens + silent artist + the model; host and artist cast new, the model from the bank

variants.name: Grandma's test bench (product explainer)
variants.what: an older woman to the lens tests the product beside a silent younger helper, one kitchen set; the nearest record to the grandma + doctor explainer (no grandma + doctor run is on file)

overrides.stages.edit.broll: phone-photo inserts; where the clip erases the skin mark, an image-to-image still + push-in

variants.name: public reaction
variants.what: demonstration · 0:11.6–0:37.5 · the product does the work on the Creator's armpit, hand, stomach and ankle. Each spray-and-wipe is one beat, showing before and after.

rulings: the owner 2026-10-10: the three-doctors ad, the TV-shopping ad and the grandma explainer are ONE family that shares one workflow, refined per variant
the owner 2026-10-03: "version a actually sounds like the avatar looks" — on-camera lines in the clip, speech-to-speech
the owner 2026-10-04: "We should never be cutting off words"; "we need the music for the whole edit"
the owner 2026-10-07 (RULINGS.md): the hook stays as the format has it; no small print; a dramatized demo is fine
the owner 2026-10-09: "only regenerate what's absolutely necessary… cover issues up with zoom ins b-roll"
